data.title: Christian Herget Appointed Managing Director of SCIENION
data.description:
BICO Group AB Class B ( (SE:BICO) ) has provided an update.

BICO Group is a life-science company focused on cell-based applications in biotech and pharma, while SCIENION specializes in ultra-low-volume precision dispensing, microarray and biosensor technologies for the life-science sector. BICO’s portfolio includes instruments, consumables, software, AI and application expertise for handling, culturing and analyzing biological material.

BICO announced that Dr. Christian Herget will become SCIENION’s managing director and join BICO’s Executive Management on January 1, 2027, reporting to President and CEO Anders Fogelberg. Herget brings more than 25 years of international leadership experience and has held senior roles at Greiner Bio-One, Eppendorf, Becton Dickinson and Miltenyi Biotec; BICO also said SCIENION is well positioned following the integration of Cellenion.

data.title: Vital Infrastructure Reports Change in Vital Healthcare Property Trust Interest
data.description:
Vital Healthcare Property ( (NZ:VHP) ) just unveiled an update.

Vital Infrastructure Property Trust, NWI Healthcare Properties LP and Northwest NZ Finance Holdings Limited agreed to sell 95,850,216 ordinary units in Vital Healthcare Property Trust for NZ$1.65 each, or NZ$158,152,856.40 in total. Forsyth Barr and Barrenjoey were appointed to arrange, manage and underwrite the disposal.

The disclosure reports that Vital Infrastructure holds 95,850,216 units, or 11.842%, down from 191,700,432 units, or 23.684%, at its last disclosure. The units are held through NZGT Security Trustee Limited and are subject to a security interest in favour of ANZ, including restrictions on disposal without consent.

data.title: Hanjin Holdings Subsidiary Reports KRW 264,681,397,056 Fuel-Cell Gas Contract
data.description:
Hanjin Heavy Industries & Construction Holdings Co., Ltd. ( (KR:003480) ) has shared an update.

Hanjin Heavy Industries & Construction Holdings reported a major management matter involving its subsidiary, Daeryun E&S; the disclosure lists the subsidiary’s proportion of total assets at 74.3%.

On Nov. 20, 2026, Daeryun E&S concluded a city gas supply contract for fuel cells with Yangju Yongam Energy for Yongam-ri, Yangju-si, Gyeonggi-do. The reported contract amount is KRW 264,681,397,056, equal to 33.8% of most recent sales of KRW 784,005,251,134.

The contract has no deposit or advance payment, with payments due by the 25th of the following month based on metered consumption. The amount was estimated using November 2026 Gyeonggi-do fuel-cell gas pricing and estimated facility-capacity volume, and may change based on actual supply volumes and approved rates.

data.title: Kyobo Securities Details KRW 9.95 Billion Equity-Linked Derivative Bond Offering
data.description:
Kyobo Securities Co., Ltd ( (KR:030610) ) has shared an announcement.

Kyobo Securities is a securities company acting as issuer and calculation agent for equity-linked derivative bonds. Series 12902 is linked to the KOSPI200 Index and Samsung Electronics common shares.

The release details a KRW 9.95 billion public offering of 1 million securities at KRW 9,950 each, with subscriptions and payment scheduled for December 11, 2026, and maturity on December 13, 2029. Subscriptions are limited to trust customers of Suhyup Bank, and the securities are unlisted and not protected deposits; investors face issuer credit, principal-loss and limited early-liquidity risks.

data.title: Want Want Reports Lower Interim Revenue and Profit
data.description:
An update from Want Want China Holdings ( (HK:0151) ) is now available.

Want Want China Holdings reported unaudited interim results for the six months ended 30 September 2026. Revenue fell 9.7% year on year to RMB10.026 billion, while gross profit declined 12.6% to RMB4.483 billion and operating profit dropped 38.3% to RMB1.394 billion.

Profit attributable to equity holders decreased 39.9% to RMB1.033 billion, with basic and diluted earnings per share falling to 8.77 RMB cents from 14.55 RMB cents. Gross margin narrowed to 44.7% from 46.2%, operating margin to 13.9% from 20.4%, and attributable profit margin to 10.3% from 15.5%.

data.description:
